title: KANE WANTS THE BALLON D'OR IN BAYERN'S MUSEUM. THEN HIT THE CROSSBAR
description:
He beat Mbappé by 28 points, passed Shilton and showed off the trophy. Then came the penalty.

Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or in October, with forty first-place votes to twenty-three for Mbappé. Then he passed Shilton's England caps record. A plaque from Shilton, a shirt from Prince William. Busy shelf.

Now he wants the Ballon d'Or in Bayern's museum. Modesty has left the building.

Before Der Klassiker he showed off the trophy. Then his penalty hit the crossbar, and Dortmund drew 2-2. The crossbar sends thanks.

Showing off the trophy before a Klassiker: pure confidence or tempting fate? Your call.
